description: The document marks the `scheduled_for_deletion` query filter of ListSecrets required, as it does every proto3 boolean that is not declared optional; the API treats it as a filter that defaults to false. Observed 2026-10-14 in the live Project: `GET /secret-manager/v1beta1/regions/fr-par/secrets?project_id=…` without it answered 200 `{"secrets":[],"total_count":0}`.
